program: Medicaid value-based payment (state documents, typical ranges)
label: Medicaid VBP - typical ranges
disclaimer: Published state guidance floors and guideline ranges (New York VBP Roadmap) and national payment mix, NOT any managed-care plan's contract. MassHealth, Minnesota IHP and Oregon figures seen only in search snippets are listed as unverified in docs/agere/VBC_RULEBOOK.md and are not compiled. Never used as settlement terms.

ny_level1_min_savings_share.unit: minimum share of savings to provider, Level 1 (upside only), if quality goals met

ny_level2_min_loss_share.unit: minimum share of losses borne by provider, Level 2

ny_guideline_level1_savings_share.unit: share of savings, >50% of quality targets met

ny_guideline_level2_max_savings_share.unit: up to this share of savings, Level 2 under budget

ny_guideline_level2_max_loss_share.unit: up to this share of losses when >50% of quality targets met

ny_level3.value: prospective capitation (PMPM or bundles); contractor assumes full responsibility for savings and losses

medicaid_payments_lan_3_4.unit: share of Medicaid payments in LAN categories 3-4, CY2023

medicaid_payments_lan_3b_4.unit: share of Medicaid payments with downside risk, CY2023
